segments.speaker: Neil
segments.text: Hello and welcome to Real Easy English, the podcast where we have real conversations in

segments.speaker: Neil
segments.text: easy English to help you learn. I'm Neil.

segments.speaker: Georgie
segments.text: And I'm Georgie. You can find a video version of this podcast with subtitles to help you learn

segments.speaker: Georgie
segments.text: over on our website, bbclearningenglish.com.

segments.speaker: Neil
segments.text: Hi Georgie, how are you?

segments.speaker: Georgie
segments.text: I'm very well, thank you. How are you?

segments.speaker: Neil
segments.text: I'm good, yes. We're talking today about sport and playing sport. Do you play sport?

segments.speaker: Georgie
segments.text: I used to play a lot of sport at school. I'm not in any team sports at the moment,

segments.speaker: Georgie
segments.text: but I do enjoy playing sports in a casual way. So, you know, at a picnic in the park,

segments.speaker: Georgie
segments.text: for example, if someone gets a bat and a ball or a frisbee. I love doing things like that,

segments.speaker: Georgie
segments.text: just for fun. What about you?

segments.speaker: Neil
segments.text: Yeah, I love sport.

segments.speaker: Neil
segments.text: I played lots of sport when I was younger.

segments.speaker: Neil
segments.text: Football, cricket, hockey, basketball.

segments.speaker: Neil
segments.text: And now my son plays lots of sport.

segments.speaker: Neil
segments.text: So sport is a big part of my life.

segments.speaker: Georgie
segments.text: Does your son mostly play team sports

segments.speaker: Neil
segments.text: Yeah he does

segments.speaker: Georgie
segments.text: Yeah and he really enjoys it What do you think are some

segments.speaker: Neil
segments.text: good things about playing team sports I think playing team sports Yeah he does Yeah And he really enjoys it

segments.speaker: Georgie
segments.text: What do you think are some good things about playing team sports

segments.speaker: Neil
segments.text: I think playing team sports is really good for you

segments.speaker: Neil
segments.text: especially for kids, because they learn about teamwork, about personal responsibility,

segments.speaker: Neil
segments.text: trying to do your best. You keep fit and you learn valuable life skills like how to lose,

segments.speaker: Neil
segments.text: how to win

segments.speaker: Georgie
segments.text: yes

segments.speaker: Neil
segments.text: um and how to deal with those emotions

segments.speaker: Georgie
segments.text: yeah how to control your emotions

segments.speaker: Georgie
segments.text: um and work in a team teamwork is very important when playing team sports obviously

segments.speaker: Georgie
segments.text: um what about individual sports what's good about that

segments.speaker: Neil
segments.text: um so i think in individual sports you don't

segments.speaker: Neil
segments.text: Maybe you don't feel the same pressure because you're playing for yourself.

segments.speaker: Neil
segments.text: And if you let someone down, that person is yourself.

segments.speaker: Neil
segments.text: But then I guess probably there's added pressure because of that sometimes.

segments.speaker: Neil
segments.text: So I think if you play tennis, it must be very lonely because you don't have a team.

segments.speaker: Neil
segments.text: And when things are down only you can help yourself

segments.speaker: Georgie
segments.text: Yeah I think I prefer playing team sports because for me the enjoyment comes from being with people and the community and things like that Individual

segments.speaker: Georgie
segments.text: sports, like you said, are a bit lonely.

segments.speaker: Neil
segments.text: Yeah. Have you ever entered a competition in sport?

segments.speaker: Georgie
segments.text: I have, actually. When I was at school, I was actually the fastest runner.

segments.speaker: Neil
segments.text: Wow.

segments.speaker: Georgie
segments.text: Yes. So I entered an athletics competition to do some sprinting.

segments.speaker: Georgie
segments.text: So sprinting is really fast running.

segments.speaker: Georgie
segments.text: I didn't do so well.

segments.speaker: Georgie
segments.text: It turns out that at school I was really good.

segments.speaker: Georgie
segments.text: But when I was competing with lots of other people, I wasn't so good.

segments.speaker: Georgie
segments.text: What about you?

segments.speaker: Neil
segments.text: Yeah, I played team sports in league and cup competitions.

segments.speaker: Neil
segments.text: So every time you play, you can go up or down in the league.

segments.speaker: Neil
segments.text: So there was that competition all the time.

segments.speaker: Georgie
segments.text: And what do you think is important when you start playing a sport?

segments.speaker: Neil
segments.text: It's important that you enjoy it mainly.

segments.speaker: Neil
segments.text: That's the most important thing, I think, because if you don't enjoy it, there's no point.

segments.speaker: Neil
segments.text: I think you need to understand that you will learn skills And if you practice and try hard you will probably get better

segments.speaker: Georgie
segments.text: Yeah.

segments.speaker: Georgie
segments.text: Don't put too much pressure on yourself, I think, is good advice.

segments.speaker: Neil
segments.text: Yeah.

segments.speaker: Neil
segments.text: Let's recap the vocabulary we've heard in today's podcast,

segments.speaker: Neil
segments.text: starting with teamwork. Teamwork is how we describe working together with other people.

segments.speaker: Georgie
segments.text: If you are competitive, it means you really want to win at something and will try really hard to do

segments.speaker: Georgie
segments.text: that.

segments.speaker: Neil
segments.text: We also heard pressure. Pressure is that feeling that you need to win and it can be quite

segments.speaker: Neil
segments.text: a stressful feeling.

segments.speaker: Georgie
segments.text: And you might feel a lot of pressure in a tournament when you need to reach

segments.speaker: Georgie
segments.text: the next level. And a tournament is a sports competition where you play against a lot of

segments.speaker: Georgie
segments.text: other teams or people to find out who is best.

segments.speaker: Neil
segments.text: That's it for this episode of Real Easy English. Don't forget to go to our website to find

segments.speaker: Neil
segments.text: a free worksheet. That's at bbclearningenglish.com.

segments.text: And we'll be back next week with another conversation in Easy English. Goodbye for now.
